## The objects

Every object used is a published source definition or a Mathlib definition.
No replacement degree datum, field, inertia group, normalized degree,
Frobenius semigroup or generated subgroup is introduced.

- `D : DegreeData G` (M010.002) is the source degree datum, with values in
  `ZHatMul = Multiplicative ZHat` (M010.001, M008.008).
- `K : FiniteResidueAbstractField D` (M010.021) bundles a closed subgroup
  `K.field : ClosedSubgroup G` with finiteness of its residue quotient;
  `K.field.toSubgroup` is the group `G_K`.
- `L : ClosedSubgroup G` (Mathlib's closed subgroups) with
  `hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.field.toSubgroup` is the extension.
  `L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup` is Mathlib's subgroup `G_L`
  of `G_K`. It is the exact body of the source abbreviation
  `extensionSubgroup K.field L hLK` (M004.002, published as the abbreviation
  `Langlands.NYLL.CyclicCohomology.extensionSubgroup`, whose inclusion-proof
  argument is unused), and the published sibling modules use it in the same
  way.
- `D.extensionInertiaWithin K.field L hLK` (M012.002) is
  `G_L ⊓ D.fieldInertiaWithin K.field`, the inertia subgroup `I_L` inside
  `G_K`, where `D.fieldInertiaWithin K.field` (M010.014) is the kernel of the
  degree on `G_K`. It is normal when `G_L` is normal (instance M012.003). The
  quotient `K.field.toSubgroup ⧸ D.extensionInertiaWithin K.field L hLK` is
  the group `G(\widetilde L|K)`. Both are published in
  `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.AbstractClassFieldTheory.Degree.FrobeniusLift.Definitions`.
- `D.extensionNormalizedDegree K L hLK` (M012.005) is the homomorphism
  `G(\widetilde L|K) →* ZHatMul` induced by the normalized degree `d_K`.
  `D.FrobeniusElements K L hLK` (M012.009) is the subtype of those
  `σ ∈ G(\widetilde L|K)` for which
  `∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ D.extensionNormalizedDegree K L hLK σ = (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZHat)) ^ n`,
  that is, whose normalized degree is a strictly positive natural number.
  Both are published in
  `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.AbstractClassFieldTheory.Degree.FrobeniusLift.FrobeniusElements.Definitions`.
- `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFormation.closedSubgroupGenerated X` (M007.003) is the
  closed subgroup of a topological group whose underlying subgroup is
  `(Subgroup.closure X).topologicalClosure`, and
  `closedSubgroupGeneratedMap φ` (M007.004) sends `a` to `φ a`, regarded as
  an element of `closedSubgroupGenerated (Set.range φ)`. Both are published in
  `Langlands.NYLL.GaloisCohomology.ProfiniteIntegers.TopologicalGeneration.Definitions`
  and require `[IsTopologicalGroup]` on the ambient group.

## Telescopes

All four declarations have the source section's implicit `G : Type u`, with
the universe variable `u` (source lines 27 and 29), followed by `[Group G]`
and `[TopologicalSpace G]`, and then the explicit and instance binders below.
No hypothesis is added. The normality binder
`[hLnormal : (L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup).Normal]` is the
source binder `[hLnormal : (extensionSubgroup K.field L hLK).Normal]` with
`extensionSubgroup` expanded.

```lean
def frobeniusExponent (D : DegreeData G) (K : FiniteResidueAbstractField D) (L : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.field.toSubgroup)
    [hLnormal : (L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup).Normal]
    (σ : D.FrobeniusElements K L hLK) : ℕ

def frobeniusClosure (D : DegreeData G) [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (K : FiniteResidueAbstractField D) (L : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.field.toSubgroup)
    [hLnormal : (L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup).Normal]
    (σ : D.FrobeniusElements K L hLK) :
    ClosedSubgroup
      (K.field.toSubgroup ⧸ D.extensionInertiaWithin K.field L hLK)

def frobeniusInClosure (D : DegreeData G) [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (K : FiniteResidueAbstractField D) (L : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.field.toSubgroup)
    [hLnormal : (L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup).Normal]
    (σ : D.FrobeniusElements K L hLK) :
    D.frobeniusClosure K L hLK σ

instance frobeniusClosure_isTopologicalGroup
    (D : DegreeData G) [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (K : FiniteResidueAbstractField D) (L : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.field.toSubgroup)
    [hLnormal : (L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup).Normal]
    (σ : D.FrobeniusElements K L hLK) :
    IsTopologicalGroup (D.frobeniusClosure K L hLK σ)
```

## Constructions

`D.frobeniusExponent K L hLK σ` (M014.012) is `Exists.choose σ.2`: the
natural number `n` chosen from the defining property of the Frobenius lift
`σ`, so that `0 < n` and the normalized degree of `σ` is `n` times the
generator `1` of `ZHat`, written multiplicatively. This is the source's
`d_K(σ)`. The body is the source's.

`D.frobeniusClosure K L hLK σ` (M014.023) is
`closedSubgroupGenerated (Set.range (fun _ : Unit => σ.1))`: the closure, in
the quotient topology of `G(\widetilde L|K)`, of the subgroup generated by the
underlying element `σ.1`. This is the closed topologically cyclic subgroup
`Γ = closure ⟨σ⟩` generated by `σ`, which the Frobenius fixed-field theorem
uses; the source calls it closed cyclic. No compactness is assumed here: the
degree datum `D` does not make `G` profinite, so at this generality `Γ` need
not be compact or procyclic in the profinite sense. The quotient is a
topological group by Mathlib's instances for subgroups of topological groups
and for quotients by normal subgroups, which is why the source binder
`[IsTopologicalGroup G]` appears. The body is the source's.

`D.frobeniusInClosure K L hLK σ` (M014.024) is
`closedSubgroupGeneratedMap (fun _ : Unit => σ.1) ()`, the element `σ.1`
together with its membership in `Γ`. The body is the source's.

The instance `frobeniusClosure_isTopologicalGroup` (M014.025) gives `Γ`,
regarded as a type, the structure of a topological group. Its proof changes
the goal to `IsTopologicalGroup ↑((D.frobeniusClosure K L hLK σ).toSubgroup)`
and closes it with `infer_instance`, using Mathlib's instance for subgroups of
a topological group. The proof is the source's.

## Modifications

Worker 5264 makes these modifications:

- Extract only M014.012, M014.023, M014.024 and M014.025, with the namespaces
  `ClassFormation` (line 19) and `DegreeData` (line 300), the noncomputable
  section (line 25), the universe declaration (line 27) and the variable
  declaration (line 29). Narrow the module documentation to these
  declarations. The source `open CyclicCohomology` (line 21) is omitted: in
  the extracted declarations it serves only to resolve `extensionSubgroup`,
  which is expanded below.
- Prefix the source namespace `ClassFormation` with `Langlands.NYLL`.
- Expand `extensionSubgroup K.field L hLK` to its exact Mathlib body
  `L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup` in the four normality binders,
  following the published sibling modules. The two expressions are
  definitionally equal, since `extensionSubgroup` is an abbreviation with
  this body.
- Replace the source imports `Nyll.ClassFieldTheory.AbstractClassFieldTheory.Degree.FrobeniusLift`,
  `Nyll.GaloisCohomology.ProfiniteIntegers.TopologicalGeneration` and
  `Nyll.GaloisCohomology.Topology.TotallyDisconnectedQuotients` with two
  published modules:
  `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.AbstractClassFieldTheory.Degree.FrobeniusLift.FrobeniusElements.Definitions`
  contains `FrobeniusElements` and `extensionNormalizedDegree` and
  transitively imports `extensionInertiaWithin` and its normality instance;
  `Langlands.NYLL.GaloisCohomology.ProfiniteIntegers.TopologicalGeneration.Definitions`
  contains `closedSubgroupGenerated` and `closedSubgroupGeneratedMap`.
- The declaration names, docstrings, remaining telescopes, result types,
  bodies and the instance proof are unchanged.
- Retain the original copyright, Apache-2.0 and author header, and add the
  explicit modification record in the Lean module documentation.

The source theorems M014.013 `frobeniusExponent_pos`, M014.014
`extensionNormalizedDegree_frobenius_eq_pow`, M014.027
`frobeniusInClosure_topologicallyGenerates`, M014.038
`frobeniusClosure_totallyDisconnectedSpace` and M014.039
`frobeniusFixedField_finiteIndex` are stated as proposition targets in the
sibling module
`Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.AbstractClassFieldTheory.Degree.FrobeniusFixedField.FrobeniusClosure.Statements`.
The other declarations of the source file, including M014.026
`frobeniusClosureCommGroup` and M014.015 `frobeniusExponent_unique`, are not
part of this contribution. These definitions discharge no host
class-formation, cup, transfer, Tate or reciprocity target.
